result.note: Draft regulatory proposal, but interstate transmission charge waivers for clean energy are a recurring Prelims theme; tested only what was proposed.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, India's power regulator proposed reinstating a waiver for renewable energy and battery storage projects stalled by grid delays. The waiver concerned which of the following?
options: Basic customs duty on battery cells
Goods and services tax on solar modules
questions.explain: The draft policy would bring back interstate transmission fee waivers, reversing a planned phase-out. It is meant to help developers who missed deadlines because of grid delays, provided they hold long-term power sale contracts through 2026.
questions.source: India’s power regulator has proposed reinstating interstate transmission fee waivers for renewable energy and battery storage projects stalled by grid delays
